verdicts.reason: A reads left to right and keeps the RSVP button as a distinct, larger CTA on the right. However, the logo collides with the 'Sunset Sessions' headline, the tagline and date details are too small to read at this size, and the red placeholder box is clipped at the bottom-right edge. B is worse: 'RSVP Free' is shrunk to the size of the FREE ENTRY, ALL AGES and TASTINGS pills and packed into a 2x2 grid with them, so the CTA is buried. B's tagline, date and time are also crammed into narrow, ragged columns, and it has the same placeholder-box artifact.
